answer: The strongest single control I know for this is SybilRank-style trust propagation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A canyon of doubt is healthy, a summit of proof is required, and a orchard of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
